title: nori init command: interactive first-time setup wizard
description: The main deliverable. nori init is an interactive CLI wizard that bootstraps a complete Nori installation. Flow: (1) Check docker/docker compose available, (2) Check for running nori-* containers via 'docker ps --filter name=nori-', warn and confirm if found, stop them, (3) Prompt for account name, admin email, admin password (with confirm), space name, optional stations (loop: name + WIP limit, blank to finish), (4) Generate random JWT secret (32-byte hex), (5) Write docker/.env with all config values including NORI_SKIP_PASSWORD_CHANGE=true, (6) Run 'docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build', (7) Poll GET http://localhost:8080/health until healthy (30s timeout, 1s interval), (8) POST /auth/login with admin creds to get JWT, (9) POST /api/spaces to create space, (10) POST /api/v1/stations for each station, (11) POST /admin/api-keys with no expiry to generate CLI API key, (12) Save credentials to ~/.config/nori/credentials with API key (not JWT), server URL, user ID, email, space ID, (13) Print success summary with next steps. Uses os/exec for docker commands. Extract promptString/promptPassword to shared internal/cli/prompt.go. Expects to be run from repo root (docker/docker-compose.dev.yml must exist).

title: Embedded migrations + nori migrate up command
description: Add golang-migrate/migrate v4 as a Go dependency. Embed server/migrations/ directory using //go:embed. Add server/cmd/migrate.go with 'nori migrate up' subcommand that connects directly to PostgreSQL via DB_* env vars and runs all pending migrations. Add nori-migrate service to docker-compose.dev.yml that runs './nori migrate up' and exits before server starts (depends_on with service_completed_successfully). This eliminates the external 'migrate' binary dependency and ensures migrations run automatically on container startup and updates.

title: Fix Dockerfile Go version + compose env vars

Convert hardcoded env vars in docker/docker-compose.dev.yml to ${VAR} references that read from docker/.env file. Add docker/.env to .gitignore. Add a docker/.env.example with placeholder values. Verify make dev still builds after changes.

title: nori init: First-Time Setup Wizard
description: Make Nori usable from scratch with a single command. nori init interactively collects admin credentials, spins up Docker containers, runs migrations, creates the first space and stations, generates a never-expiring API key for CLI auth, and saves everything to ~/.config/nori/credentials. Depends on nori-m81 (CLI epic) being done first.

title: Fix Docker boot: make dev works end-to-end
description: Fix Docker Compose so 'make dev' starts the full stack. Issues: (1) Dockerfile CMD is ['./nori'] but should be ['./nori', 'serve']. (2) Missing env vars in docker-compose.dev.yml (NORI_JWT_SECRET, NORI_ADMIN_EMAIL, etc). (3) Run 'make migrate-up' and verify app starts, DB is reachable, health endpoint responds. This is the foundation for all integration testing.

title: CLI-First End-to-End
description: Make Nori fully usable from the terminal. Ship seed TOML recipes for real shop projects (chair, cutting board). Implement the complete CLI workflow: login -> create recipe -> pour -> ready -> claim -> complete -> job show. Fix Docker boot so make dev works. End goal: model the chair workflow and other shop projects entirely from the command line. Depends on nori-rup (bug fixes) being done first.

title: Add space-scoping to single-resource endpoints
description: GetTask, UpdateTask, DeleteTask, ClaimTask, CompleteTask, PauseTask fetch by ID without verifying the task belongs to the requester's space. Same for GetRecipe, UpdateRecipe, DeleteRecipe, and version endpoints. After fetching the resource, verify resource.SpaceID matches the authenticated user's space. Return 404 if mismatch (not 403, to avoid leaking existence).

title: Fix CLI SpaceID not sent with requests
description: cli.Client has a SpaceID field that sends X-Space-ID header, but NewClient() never populates it. All task/recipe CLI commands will fail with 400. Fix: add 'space' field to ~/.nori/config.yaml and credentials. Add --space global flag to CLI. Send X-Space-ID on every authenticated request. Spec reference: specs/cli.md line 161.

title: Fix handler auth nil-pointer panic
description: All handlers do c.Locals('authDTO').(*dtos.AuthDTO) which panics if middleware didn't set the value. Change to safe type assertion: authDTO, ok := c.Locals('authDTO').(*dtos.AuthDTO); if !ok || authDTO == nil { return 401 }. Affects: task.handler.go, recipe.handler.go.

title: Task + Recipe Architecture
description:
Implement the new Task + Recipe architecture for Nori, replacing the old Ticket/SOP model.

Core components:
- Task model with hierarchical string IDs and dependency graph
- Recipe + RecipeVersion models (TOML stored in database)
- Formula engine (extracted from beads) for pouring Recipes into Tasks
- Ready-work algorithm for pull-based task execution
- HTTP API, CLI commands, and flow board UI

See specs/data-model.md, specs/recipes.md, specs/task-execution.md, specs/job-flow.md, specs/cli.md for full details.

title: US-003: Implement batch_size resolution in the pour engine

creating tasks, using explicit values or inheritance from the dependency chain.

## Acceptance Criteria

  formula package walks the step graph and sets BatchSize on every step
- [ ] Steps with explicit batch_size keep their value
- [ ] Steps without batch_size inherit from their dependency chain: if all deps
  agree, use that value; if deps disagree or have no deps, use the recipe-level
  default
- [ ] Inheritance follows Needs/DependsOn references
- [ ] Unit tests cover: explicit override, single-dep inheritance, multi-dep
  agreement, multi-dep disagreement (falls back to default), no-dep default

title: Ready-work service
description:
Port the ready-work algorithm from beads to PostgreSQL + GORM.

Create server/internal/services/ready_work_service.go:
- ReadyWorkService struct with *gorm.DB dependency
- GetReadyTasks(spaceID uuid.UUID) ([]models.Task, error)

Algorithm (from beads internal/storage/issueops/ready_work.go):
1. Find all open tasks in the space
2. Compute blocked set: tasks that have unresolved blocking deps (TaskDep where Type=blocks and ToTask.Status != done)
3. Exclude children of blocked parents
4. Return open AND NOT blocked tasks, sorted by Priority ASC, CreatedAt ASC

PostgreSQL adaptations from SQLite:
- Replace backtick quoting with double quotes
- Replace JSON_EXTRACT with jsonb operators (->>, @>)
- Replace IFNULL with COALESCE
- Use PostgreSQL-compatible CTEs if needed

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ReadyWorkService with GetReadyTasks method
- [ ] Correctly excludes tasks with unresolved blocking deps
- [ ] Excludes children of blocked parents
- [ ] Sorted by priority then creation time

title: US-005: Implement dependency wiring across batch boundaries
description:
As the pour engine, I need to wire task dependencies correctly when upstream and
downstream steps have different batch sizes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 1:1 (same ticket count): Task N depends on task N. Both steps produce the
  same number of tickets.
- [ ] Fan-out (fewer -> more tickets): All downstream tickets depend on the
  single (or fewer) upstream ticket(s). Example: resaw-veneers (1 ticket) ->
  glue-lamination (6 tickets): all 6 depend on the 1.
- [ ] Fan-in (more -> fewer tickets): The single downstream ticket depends on
  ALL upstream tickets. Example: install-seat (6 tickets) -> done (1 ticket):
  done depends on all 6.
- [ ] Dependency wiring handles the case where both deps have different ticket
  counts that converge on the same downstream step (e.g., glue-up depends on
  dry-fit (1 ticket, fan-out) and shape-back (6 tickets, 1:1))
- [ ] Unit tests cover all three wiring patterns plus mixed-dependency convergence

- [ ] createChildTasks (or a new function) calculates ticket count:
  order_qty / effective_batch_size (integer division, must divide evenly or error)
- [ ] For batch steps (ticket count = 1): creates 1 task with
  Quantity = batch_size, title is the step title as-is
- [ ] For per-piece steps (ticket count > 1): creates N tasks, each with

  Example: "Glue lamination — {{n}} of {{batch_count}}"
- [ ] Each created task is tracked in a map: stepID -> []taskID (list because
  per-piece steps create multiple tasks)

value: Key implementation details for nori-uu4: (1) Go version locally is 1.26.1, Dockerfile says golang:1.25-alpine which doesnt exist - fix to golang:alpine or golang:1.24-alpine. (2) Station repo already has Create() and GetMaxDisplayOrder() - just need handler endpoint + CLI command. nori init design: CLI wizard shells out to docker compose (os/exec, no Docker SDK). Writes docker/.env with user config (email, password, account name, JWT secret, NORI_SKIP_PASSWORD_CHANGE=true). Compose file uses ${VAR} references. Polls /health until server up. Then HTTP calls: login -> create space -> create stations -> generate API key (no expiry). Saves API key (not JWT) to ~/.config/nori/credentials. Run from repo root (expects docker/docker-compose.dev.yml).

Architecture spec created at specs/architecture.md. Added to spec index as item 0. Covers system diagram, all components, communication patterns, deployment model, multi-tenancy, auth flow, design principles. specs/cli.md already has nori init specced in the How section.

Compose migration pattern: Add nori-migrate service that runs './nori migrate up' and exits. Server depends on it with condition: service_completed_successfully. Need to add golang-migrate/migrate v4 as Go dep, embed migrations/ with go:embed, create server/cmd/migrate.go. The migrate command connects directly to Postgres via DB_* env vars (only command that does direct DB access).

Dependency graph: uu4.1 (Dockerfile fix) unblocks uu4.2 (embedded migrations). uu4.3 (station create API+CLI) and uu4.4 (seed MustChangePassword env) are independent. uu4.5 (nori init command) depends on ALL of 1-4. uu4.6 (tests) depends on 5.
